title: Suramar and the Nightwell
summary: Suramar's ancient refuge becomes a modern point of dependence and conflict when the Legion returns and rebellion grows under Elisande's rule.
opening: A city that survived the Sundering by sheltering behind its own power eventually had to decide what that survival had cost.

chapters.title: A refuge from the Sundering
chapters.body: Examine Elisande's ancient choice, the creation of the Nightwell, and the city's isolation. Confirm the sequence against Chronicle and in-game Suramar records.

chapters.title: The Legion's demand
chapters.body: Gul'dan's pressure places the Nightwell and Suramar's survival at the center of a new war. The original campaign should settle Elisande's options and response.

chapters.title: The rebellion
chapters.body: Follow the resistance within and around the city, including the Nightborne whose lives depend on the Nightwell. Distinguish the city's people from its ruler's decision.

chapters.title: The Nighthold
chapters.body: Review the assault on the Nighthold and the Nightwell's fate from released raid and quest evidence before writing the final outcome.

reviewNote: The raid preview is an entry point; capture original Suramar campaign and Nighthold text. Review the ancient prologue separately from the modern rebellion.
